messages:
anna_ml: Quick update — finished conversion of the new checkpoint drop to safetensors. Files uploaded to s3://redwood-models/onboarding/mistral-v1.

anna_ml: Found a tokenizer quirk: vocab size changed (50278 -> 50280) because two special tokens were added downstream. Padding token id is 1 in the HF tokenizer but the model config expects 0. We should align before packaging.

simon_infra: Thanks. Can you paste the exact path and the shard layout? I need to wire it into the serving deploy job.

anna_ml: Path: s3://redwood-models/onboarding/mistral-v1/safetensors/
Files are sharded into 8 files named checkpoint-00001-of-00008.safetensors ... checkpoint-00008-of-00008.safetensors
Metadata included at s3://redwood-models/onboarding/mistral-v1/metadata.json

kevin_runtime: Are the shards TP-friendly? i.e. row vs col parallel layout? We need TP-split naming like tp_rank0_..., or runtime won't map KV cache correctly.

anna_ml: Current converter produced canonical Hugging Face sharding (slice-based). I added a post-process that renames to our TP format: model.tp_4.rank.0.safetensors etc. The metadata.json includes "tp_size": "4" and a map for shard->tp_rank.

lina_sre: Is the dtype fp16 or bf16? Any catastrophic NaNs in quick sanity run?

anna_ml: We converted to fp16 to save footprint. Quick forward pass on a small prompt (len 64) looked stable, no NaNs. But fp16 logits showed small divergence vs bf16 baseline. Might need bf16 for long-range stability.

kevin_runtime: For the serving SLOs I'd prefer bf16 if memory allows. Can we provide both variants or a fallback? Also add quantization tags if available.

anna_ml: I can re-run conversion to bf16 but will need ~2 hours to re-encode and re-upload. For fallback, we can publish two model variants: mistral-v1-fp16 and mistral-v1-bf16 and wire routing policy to pick bf16 for long-context routes.

simon_infra: Also validate config fields: ensure model_max_length, pad_token_id, eos_token_id, tp_size, tp_layout are present. The deployment validator will reject otherwise. Use tools/validate_model.py before triggering the package CI.

anna_ml: Good call. Example snippet I used to validate:

```
# local validation
python tools/validate_model.py \
  --model-dir s3://redwood-models/onboarding/mistral-v1/ \
  --expected-tp-size 4 \
  --dtype fp16
```

simon_infra: Perfect. Ping me when validator passes and I'll add the model to the canary pool. Also include a small promptset in the artifacts for quality gating.

ann a_ml: (typo) sorry — anna_ml: Will add promptset under s3://redwood-models/onboarding/mistral-v1/eval/prompts.jsonl

deploy-bot: CI job #8423 finished: conversion -> safetensors -> rename -> upload. Status: success. Artifacts: s3://redwood-models/onboarding/mistral-v1/

kevin_runtime: Quick prod note — runtime expects shards named: model.tp{TP_SIZE}.rank{RANK}.safetensors (e.g., model.tp4.rank0.safetensors). If metadata maps differently, we'll need a small shim in the loader.

anna_ml: Done — I added a tiny manifest called redwood_model_manifest.txt listing each shard, tp_rank, byte-range and tokenizer hash. Example entry:
```
model.tp4.rank0.safetensors	shard_index:0	tp_rank:0	sha256:abcd1234
```

lina_sre: Approving once validate_model passes and we get a green canary. Also add KMS key tag for the private deploy (customer request).

anna_ml: KMS tag added to metadata.json under kms_key_id. Will run bf16 conversion tonight and upload separate prefix.

simon_infra: Thanks — ping me when bf16 is up and I'll schedule a rolling canary across dedicated GPU nodes.

kevin_runtime: Leaving a small review comment on PR #8423: please include the tokenizer.vocab_size check in the CI step so we catch the +2 special tokens earlier.

anna_ml: Will update PR and add CI step.

lina_sre: tiny checklist for closure:
- [ ] validate_model.py -> pass
- [ ] manifest and metadata.json include tp_size, tp_layout, pad_token_id
- [ ] promptset uploaded
- [ ] bf16 variant available (or routing configured)
- [ ] KMS tag

anna_ml: I'll update this thread as each item completes. Thanks all :thumbsup:
